# ToolPitara

> ToolPitara is a free box of simple online tools: EMI, SIP and GST calculators and a photo & signature resizer for exam forms. Every tool runs entirely in the visitor's browser — no sign-up, no uploads; your numbers and photos never leave your device. The site is made for students and everyday users in India who need quick, accurate everyday calculations.

## Tools

- [EMI Calculator](https://toolpitarawala.github.io/tools/emi-calculator.html): Calculate your loan EMI online, free.
- [SIP Calculator](https://toolpitarawala.github.io/tools/sip-calculator.html): See how a monthly SIP investment could grow over time.
- [GST Calculator](https://toolpitarawala.github.io/tools/gst-calculator.html): Add or remove GST, with the CGST/SGST/IGST split shown.
- [Photo & Signature Resizer](https://toolpitarawala.github.io/tools/photo-signature-resizer.html): Resize a photo or signature to the exact KB size that exam and application forms ask for.
